recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Any remaining Bundle/history or PATCH wording questions should be handled under their own issue family, not under this collection-specific tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-38942 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 ballot issue asking to add a constraint checking that Bundle entries have resources when Bundle.type is collection. The accepted resolution was to move Bundle entry resource SHALL rules into invariants and remove redundant SHALL prose while retaining other explanatory language.
initial_application: Git commit 7fd7b9ce04e0675f40e902ba468f696a851dd51a applied the issue by adding bdl-3a through bdl-3d to source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml and removing redundant SHALL wording from Bundle notes, including the collection paragraph.
additional_context: Bundle is active current-build source in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-I 2022-10-17 minutes corroborate the 12-0-0 Persuasive vote. No Zulip records or conflicting Confluence records were found. Later Bundle/history reconciliation work cites FHIR-38942 as context but leaves bdl-3a intact.
reconciliation: Made no source change. Current bdl-3a requires entries in document, message, searchset, and collection Bundles to contain resources and omit request/response, and the collection narrative already avoids redundant SHALL language.

related_jiras.note: An existing current-run history-entry reconciliation cites FHIR-38942 as the later invariant source for history rules, but it does not change the collection bdl-3a decision audited here.
